description: This file contains a test class for the V8 API module in SuiteCRM, specifically testing the deletion of a module record through API endpoints. It uses Codeception testing framework with methods to test successful deletion and failure scenarios.

classes.name: DeleteModuleCest
classes.description: Test class for API module deletion endpoints in SuiteCRM, containing methods for setup and specific delete module tests.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test; logs into the API as a preliminary step.

methods.name: shouldWork
methods.description: Test case verifying successful deletion of a module record via API, checking response code, JSON response structure, and confirming deletion.

methods.name: shouldNotWork
methods.description: Test case verifying behavior when attempting to access a deleted module record, expecting an error response.
